description: Make a PDF smaller with Ghostscript, at a chosen quality: smallest (screen reading), balanced (email and sharing, default), print, or prepress (keeps colour profiles). Can keep only the first page. Text-only PDFs may not shrink; the result then says so. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

file.description: The PDF to compress. Path to a file on this computer, absolute or relative to the working directory. Accepts: application/pdf.

saveTo.description: Optional. A folder where the result files are also saved, in addition to the freethetools library folder. It must be inside the working directory, the library, or a folder the person allowed with --allow-save, and not inside a hidden folder. Files that can run programs, such as .bat or .exe, are never saved. Existing files are never overwritten.

name: compress_pdf
title: Compress PDF
